interpretation_limits: Price and refinement quantities are currency with S0=100; time is years; probability arrays use fractions and figures use percentage points.
The Asian sampling interval is approximate pointwise normal sampling uncertainty only. Empirical coupled step/surface changes are diagnostics, not rigorous discretization-bias bounds.

The threshold adds the Asian sampling half width, each model's Asian step refinement and the pilot Asian surface change. PDE vanilla residual is a separate vanilla diagnostic and is not added as an Asian error bound.
Finite 20 quotes plus 8 holdouts and stochastic vanilla guards do not prove equality of the entire vanilla surface or all one-time marginals.

Two-date differences are descriptive pointwise comparisons; main automated identification/acceptance concerns the Asian price. No simultaneous bin coverage, equality of joint laws, or market superiority is asserted.

Constant-edge wings and minimum-time proxy are explicit numerical extensions. Unsupported source cells retain NaN, wing paths remain included, and negative full-truncation variance states are counted.
Conditional minimum denominator support does not guarantee normal-interval reliability; sparse successes or joint SE=0 cannot establish probability zero.

With constant r,q and square-integrable stock-martingale assumptions, exact same one-time marginals imply equal fixed arithmetic-average mean and variance; an Asian call difference depends on other distributional features. This theorem is distinct from the finite numerical checks.
